drNote: Domain Rating is approximate. ahrefs-snapshot-2026-09-06 is an Ahrefs point-in-time snapshot from 6 Sep 2026. site-stated-2026-10-11 is the number that directory printed on its own pricing page on 11 Oct 2026. A blank DR means we did not have a figure worth citing.
priceNote: confirmed prices were checked against the directory's public pricing on 11 Oct 2026, or the listing is plainly free to post. snapshot prices come from a 6 Sep 2026 public listing and are marked with a tilde. Check site means the current fee was not verified.
dofollowNote: yes/no/mixed come from a sample of listing links on 6 Sep 2026, or from a direct check (Hacker News and Reddit are nofollow). premium means the paid tier is dofollow and the free tier is not. unknown was not measured.

directories.name: EarlyHunt
directories.notes: Weekly AI and startup launch competition on this site. Free launches need a badge and stay nofollow unless you finish top 3. Premium is $19 once: guaranteed dofollow, skip the queue, Launch Kit, and social posts. Pricing page states DR 66.

directories.name: IndieHunt
directories.notes: Weekly indie launch platform in this network. Free listing, or Premium at $19 for a guaranteed dofollow. Ahrefs snapshot on 6 Sep 2026 was DR 62; the pricing page stated DR 65 on 11 Oct 2026.

directories.name: MakerHunt
directories.notes: Weekly launches for maker projects in this network. Free listing, or Premium at $19 for a guaranteed dofollow. Pricing page states DR 49.

directories.name: SideHunt
directories.notes: Weekly side-project launches in this network. Free listing, or Premium at $19 for a guaranteed dofollow. Pricing page states DR 46.

directories.name: Aura++
directories.notes: Daily AI-product launch platform in this network. Premium is $29 and Premium Plus is $69, checked 11 Oct 2026. Paid tiers include a guaranteed dofollow. The site states DR 72.

directories.name: Uno Directory
directories.notes: Productivity, AI, and SaaS directory in this network. Free if you add a backlink, or $10 one-time. Pricing page says the paid listing is dofollow and states DR 70.

directories.name: Product Hunt
directories.notes: The default launch-day community for tech products. Posting a product is free. Traffic depends on comments and votes, not on a listing fee.

directories.name: BetaList
directories.notes: Pre-launch startups and waitlists. There is a free queue and a paid skip-the-line option. Confirm the current skip price on BetaList before paying.

directories.name: Hacker News Show HN
directories.notes: Show HN is a front-page conversation with developers, not a directory slot. Story links are nofollow, so use it for feedback and technical readers.

directories.name: Indie Hackers
directories.notes: Community of bootstrapped founders. Post a product milestone or launch story. Good for peers and feedback; treat any SEO value as unknown.

directories.name: Peerlist
directories.notes: Professional network for builders. Launchpad is a free way to put a product in front of other makers. Dofollow was not verified.

directories.name: DevHunt
directories.notes: Product Hunt-style weekly launches aimed at developer tools. Check the current submission rules and link attribute before you count on SEO.

directories.name: Uneed
directories.notes: Curated tech-product directory with a free queue and a paid skip. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $14.99, DR ~75, and sampled listing links were dofollow.

directories.name: Fazier
directories.notes: Clean product-discovery site used as a Product Hunt alternative. Pricing and link attribute were not re-measured for this list.

directories.name: TinyLaunch
directories.notes: Micro-startup launch platform. Sep 2026 snapshot listed about $39 and DR ~73. Whether the listing link is dofollow was not determined.

directories.name: Microlaunch
directories.notes: Short-queue product launches. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $39, DR ~63, sampled listing links dofollow.

directories.name: LaunchIgniter
directories.notes: Startup exposure platform. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $15, DR ~74, sampled listing links dofollow.

directories.name: PeerPush
directories.notes: Early-user launch platform. peerpush.net redirects here. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $39, DR ~74, sampled links dofollow.

directories.name: NickLaunches
directories.notes: Launch platform for builders and SaaS founders. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $19, DR ~74, sampled links dofollow.

directories.name: StartupBase
directories.notes: Startup listing and discovery. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $15, DR ~73. A sample of listing links was mixed, so confirm the tier you would buy.

directories.name: Open-Launch
directories.notes: Open-source launch platform. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $12, DR ~72, mixed listing links. Not the same site as openlaunch.io.

directories.name: Startup Fast
directories.notes: Paid startup launch listings. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $19, DR ~72, mixed links. Different product from Startup Fame (startupfa.me).

directories.name: Startup Fame
directories.notes: Directory for newly launched startups. Separate from Startup Fast. Current price and dofollow were not measured.

directories.name: TinyShelf
directories.notes: Tool shelf for SaaS products. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $19, DR ~71, mixed listing links.

directories.name: Tiny Startups
directories.notes: Indie startup directory. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $49 and DR ~71. Link attribute was not determined.

directories.name: Launch Llama
directories.notes: Launch platform with newsletter distribution. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $39, DR ~71, sampled links dofollow.

directories.name: Findly Tools
directories.notes: Tool directory with a high Sep 2026 Ahrefs snapshot (DR ~81) and a listed price around $29. Dofollow was not determined.

directories.name: StackShare
directories.notes: Dev-tool and tech-stack directory. Sep 2026 snapshot: free listing, DR ~78. Link attribute was not determined.

directories.name: LaunchVault
directories.notes: Lower-priced launch listings. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $9.99, DR ~55, mixed links.

directories.name: StartupTrusted
directories.notes: Startup directory. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $9, DR ~54, sampled links dofollow.

directories.name: Ramen.tools
directories.notes: Free tool listing. Sep 2026 snapshot DR ~47. Dofollow was not determined.

directories.name: NoonLaunch
directories.notes: Launch directory. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $11, DR ~45, sampled links dofollow. Not part of the EarlyHunt network.

directories.name: DevHub
directories.notes: Developer project listings. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $9.90, DR ~39, sampled links nofollow.

directories.name: Shipyard HQ
directories.notes: Developer launch board. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $9.99, DR ~35. Link attribute was not determined.

directories.name: Resource.fyi
directories.notes: Resource directory. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $49, DR ~31, sampled links nofollow.

directories.name: OpenHunts
directories.notes: Open alternative to Product Hunt for product launches. Confirm submission cost and link type on the site.

directories.name: OpenLaunch
directories.notes: Product discovery and launches at openlaunch.io. Not the same property as Open-Launch (open-launch.com). Price and dofollow were not measured.

directories.name: Firsto
directories.notes: Indie product launch platform. Often mentioned next to smaller hunt sites. Current fee and link attribute not measured.

directories.name: SuperLaunch
directories.notes: Product launch site for new tools. Confirm whether a free queue exists before you budget for it.

directories.name: Product Watch
directories.notes: Daily feed of new tech products and startups. Useful for ongoing discovery, not only a one-day hunt.

directories.name: Smol Launch
directories.notes: Weekly curated startup launches. Check the current submission window and price.

directories.name: WhatLaunched.Today
directories.notes: Daily tracker of products that launched. Good for spotting where attention already is.

directories.name: NextGen Tools
directories.notes: Tool discovery directory with an SEO angle. Confirm the listing fee and whether links are followed.

directories.name: Launching Next
directories.notes: Long-running startup announcement board. Submission rules have changed over the years, so read the current form.

directories.name: Launch Directories
directories.notes: A directory of launch directories. Useful while planning a campaign; confirm if they still accept product listings.

directories.name: PitchWall
directories.notes: Startup showcase. BetaPage now redirects here, so do not submit to both.

directories.name: SideProjectors
directories.notes: Marketplace where makers list, buy, and sell side projects. A listing is distribution, not automatically a dofollow.

directories.name: TrustMRR
directories.notes: Founders publish verified revenue. Useful proof next to a launch, rather than a vote-based hunt.

directories.name: Ctrlalt
directories.notes: Curated startup directory. Selection may matter more than an open submit button.

directories.name: Startup Heroes
directories.notes: Startup showcase for new products. Confirm review time and any fee before you add it to a launch week.

directories.name: Startups FYI
directories.notes: Startup directory aimed at people browsing new companies. Price and link type not measured.

directories.name: Startup Buffer
directories.notes: Older startup listing site still referenced in launch roundups. Confirm it is accepting submissions.

directories.name: Startup Inspire
directories.notes: Gallery of startups by category. Check whether new submissions are open.

directories.name: Killer Startups
directories.notes: Long-running startup writeups. Editorial coverage, not an instant self-serve badge.

directories.name: Startup Ranking
directories.notes: Ranks startups by an internal score. A profile can help discovery; do not assume a followed link.

directories.name: StartupBlink
directories.notes: Global startup map and ecosystem directory. Better for company presence than a one-day launch spike.

directories.name: AllTopStartups
directories.notes: Startup stories and a submission path used in older launch lists. Confirm the form still leads to a public listing.

directories.name: BetaBound
directories.notes: Beta-tester announcements. Fit is pre-launch products that want testers, not a general SaaS directory.

directories.name: F6S
directories.notes: Startup profiles plus accelerators, grants, and perks. Creating a company profile is free.

directories.name: Wellfound
directories.notes: Startup and job profiles, formerly AngelList Talent. A company page is free and is where candidates look, not a hunt feed.

directories.name: Crunchbase
directories.notes: The company database investors search. A basic profile is free; richer data and some distribution are paid.

directories.name: SourceForge
directories.notes: Software hosting and a public project directory. Creating an open-source or downloadable project is free.

directories.name: There's An AI For That
directories.notes: Large AI-tool directory with real search demand. Listing terms change; confirm price and whether the link is followed.

directories.name: Futurepedia
directories.notes: Curated AI tools and guides. A common early stop for AI launches. Fee and dofollow not measured here.

directories.name: FutureTools
directories.notes: AI tools sorted by category. Editorial curation, so a submit does not guarantee a listing.

directories.name: Toolify
directories.notes: Searchable AI tool directory. High browse volume. Confirm the current sponsor or listing price.

directories.name: TopAI.tools
directories.notes: AI tools directory that ranks products inside categories. Often used for SEO as much as for users.

directories.name: Dang.ai
directories.notes: Directory of AI products and startups. Check if listings are free, reviewed, or sponsored.

directories.name: ToolWorthy
directories.notes: AI tool profiles with alternatives and category pages. Read whether a listing is editorial or paid.

directories.name: AI Valley
directories.notes: AI ecosystem directory. Useful if your buyers are searching for AI tools by job to be done.

directories.name: AIStage
directories.notes: AI product listings. Confirm the submission path is open and what the link attribute is.

directories.name: AISOTools
directories.notes: AI tools directory that also talks about AI-search visibility. Treat pricing as unconfirmed until you see the form.

directories.name: ShowMeBestAI
directories.notes: AI tool rankings and lists. A fit when the product is clearly an AI utility.

directories.name: That AI Collection
directories.notes: Collected AI tools by category. Check whether new submissions are reviewed by hand.

directories.name: BasedTools
directories.notes: AI tool directory. Confirm fee and dofollow on the live submit page.

directories.name: Altern
directories.notes: AI alternatives directory. Useful when buyers compare you with a known AI product.

directories.name: Open Tools
directories.notes: Open directory of AI tools. Listing policy was not re-checked for price or link type.

directories.name: AIxploria
directories.notes: Large AI tool index with category browsing. Confirm the current paid options before you submit.

directories.name: GPTStore
directories.notes: Directory of custom GPTs and AI apps. Best fit is a GPT or agent, not a general SaaS.

directories.name: AI Agent Store
directories.notes: Listings aimed at AI agents. Skip it if the product is not an agent or automation tool.

directories.name: BroUseAI
directories.notes: AI browsing directory. Another category page for AI-tool searches.

directories.name: Look AI Tools
directories.notes: AI tools list. Confirm it still reviews new submissions and what a listing costs.

directories.name: Dokey AI
directories.notes: AI tool directory. Price and dofollow were not measured.

directories.name: Powerusers
directories.notes: Directory for people comparing AI power-user tools. Check submission rules on the site.

directories.name: AI Parabellum
directories.notes: AI tools directory. Use it as an extra category listing, not as a measured backlink.

directories.name: AI Tool Trek
directories.notes: AI tool trek / directory. Fee and link attribute not verified.

directories.name: SEOFAI
directories.notes: AI tools with an SEO audience. A fit for search, content, or marketing AI products.

directories.name: AI Marketing Directory
directories.notes: Directory of AI marketing tools. Better for marketing products than for developer infrastructure.

directories.name: Hack the Prompt
directories.notes: Prompt and AI-tool collection. Narrower audience than a general startup directory.

directories.name: JustLaunched
directories.notes: Board of newly launched SaaS products. Check how long a listing stays on the front page.

directories.name: SubmitMySaaS
directories.notes: SaaS submission site marketed around backlinks. Verify the link is dofollow on a live listing before you pay.

directories.name: SaaSHub
directories.notes: SaaS alternatives directory with real comparison traffic. You can suggest a product for free; paid placement is separate.

directories.name: AlternativeTo
directories.notes: The comparison site people use when they want a replacement. Suggesting a product is free. Link attribute not re-measured.

directories.name: OpenAlternative
directories.notes: Open-source alternatives to popular software. Strong fit only if the product is open source.

directories.name: Alternative.me
directories.notes: Another alternatives directory. Useful when buyers search 'X alternative'.

directories.name: Slant
directories.notes: Community recommendations ('what is the best X'). Free to participate. Outcomes depend on being recommended, not on a paid slot.

directories.name: G2
directories.notes: Major B2B software reviews. A vendor profile can be free; ads and some profile features are paid. Buyers trust reviews here more than a hunt badge.

directories.name: Capterra
directories.notes: Software discovery and reviews owned alongside GetApp and Software Advice. Basic vendor presence and paid leads are different products.

directories.name: GetApp
directories.notes: SMB software directory and reviews. Same family as Capterra. Use it for buyers comparing categories, not for a launch-day spike.

directories.name: Software Advice
directories.notes: Software reviews and advisor calls. A listing supports buyer research; confirm the current vendor program.

directories.name: Crozdesk
directories.notes: Software comparison and vendor listings. Confirm whether you want their paid lead program.

directories.name: GoodFirms
directories.notes: Reviews of software and service companies. More of a research listing than a launch community.

directories.name: Tekpon
directories.notes: Software reviews and alternatives. Check if a profile is editorial, free, or sponsored.

directories.name: Serchen
directories.notes: SaaS reviews directory. Useful for category pages buyers already search.

directories.name: SaaSWorthy
directories.notes: SaaS comparison and reviews. Confirm listing fees before adding it to a backlink plan.

directories.name: Software World
directories.notes: Software reviews and roundups. Treat any SEO claim as unconfirmed.

directories.name: Appscribed
directories.notes: App and SaaS reviews. Editorial, so pitching is not the same as an instant listing.

directories.name: ToolFame
directories.notes: Tool directory. Sep 2026 snapshot: about $14.99, DR ~75, mixed listing links.

directories.name: Toolfolio
directories.notes: Tool directory. toolfolio.io redirects here. Price and dofollow were not measured.

directories.name: Twelve Tools
directories.notes: Collections of useful web tools. A fit for small utilities and maker tools.

directories.name: MagicBox
directories.notes: Curated tools directory. Confirm the submit path and fee.

directories.name: Toolkitly
directories.notes: Tools directory for discovery. Listing terms not measured.

directories.name: SaaS Genius
directories.notes: SaaS listing site. Confirm whether placement is free, reviewed, or paid.

directories.name: SaaS Gallery
directories.notes: Gallery of SaaS products. Another category listing for software searches.

directories.name: SaaS Pirate
directories.notes: SaaS directory. Price and link type not verified.

directories.name: SaaSCity
directories.notes: SaaS directory presented as an isometric city map. Memorable, but confirm what a listing includes.

directories.name: FoundrList
directories.notes: Founder-oriented tool list. Check the submission rules before you rely on it.

directories.name: LibHunt
directories.notes: Ranks open-source libraries and alternatives. Best fit is an open-source project, not a closed SaaS.

directories.name: AIWget
directories.notes: Directory of AI agents, automation, and developer software. Narrower than a general startup list.

directories.name: ScoutForge
directories.notes: Developer tool discovery. Use it when the buyer is an engineer.

directories.name: Public APIs
directories.notes: Index of public APIs. Only relevant if you are shipping an API developers can call.

directories.name: API List
directories.notes: Fun, browsable API list. Same caveat: list it if developers integrate with you.

directories.name: Nocode List
directories.notes: Directory of no-code tools. Skip it unless makers can build with your product without code.

directories.name: MakerPad
directories.notes: No-code tutorials and tools, now in the Zapier orbit. Check whether new tool submissions are still accepted.

directories.name: BestWebDesignTools
directories.notes: Directory of web design tools. A fit for design, UI, or landing-page products.

directories.name: Phyco
directories.notes: Website catalogue with user reviews across categories. Confirm how a new site gets listed.

directories.name: Sustainability Softwares
directories.notes: Niche directory of sustainability software. Use it only if that is the buyer's category.

directories.name: Invent List
directories.notes: List of inventions and new products. Better for a novel product than for a generic SaaS feature.

directories.name: Product Canyon
directories.notes: Product launch listings. Confirm fee and dofollow on a current listing page.

directories.name: SoloPush
directories.notes: Launches aimed at solo founders. Audience match matters more than an unknown DR.

directories.name: ProductBurst
directories.notes: Quick exposure board for new tools. Check how listings are ordered and what they cost.

directories.name: Slocco
directories.notes: Smaller product discovery site. Verify it is actively posting new launches.

directories.name: Reviano
directories.notes: Startup listing site included because it is live and used in launch roundups. Confirm the offer on the page before you submit.

directories.name: Micro SaaS Examples
directories.notes: Examples of micro-SaaS businesses. A fit when the story is a small, specific product.

directories.name: MadGenius
directories.notes: AI and tool listings. Price and link type not measured.

directories.name: BotsFloor
directories.notes: Bot and AI agent listings. Skip it for products that are not bots.

directories.name: Dan Recommends
directories.notes: Personal recommendation site and newsletter. Coverage is editorial, not a self-serve directory slot.

directories.name: Stacker News
directories.notes: Link community with sats for posts, closer to Hacker News than to a SaaS directory. Posting is free.

directories.name: Dev.to
directories.notes: Developer blogging community. A launch post or tutorial can reach engineers. External links in posts should be treated as user content.

directories.name: Hashnode
directories.notes: Developer blogs. Useful for a technical launch story you can also share on your own domain later.

directories.name: WIP
directories.notes: Build-in-public community. Accountability and peers, not a directory backlink.

directories.name: Starter Story
directories.notes: Case studies of how founders got customers. Editorial interviews, not an open listing form.

directories.name: The Changelog
directories.notes: Developer podcast and news. You can pitch an open-source or developer product. Coverage is editorial.

directories.name: Hacker Noon
directories.notes: Tech publishing community. A story can outlast a launch day. Read their contributor rules; this is not a paid directory slot.

directories.name: Lobsters
directories.notes: Invite-style computing community. High signal, small audience. Do not expect a dofollow campaign.

directories.name: Reddit r/SideProject
directories.notes: Makers sharing side projects. Reddit marks user links nofollow. Worth it for feedback and the occasional traffic spike.

directories.name: Reddit r/SaaS
directories.notes: SaaS founders and buyers. Read the self-promo rules. Links are nofollow, so this is for conversation, not link equity.

directories.name: Reddit r/startups
directories.notes: Startup discussion. Pure launch posts are often removed. Useful when you have a specific question or story. Links are nofollow.

directories.name: Indie Hackers Reddit
directories.notes: Reddit mirror of the indie hacker audience. Nofollow links. Use it if you already have something concrete to show.

directories.name: r/alphaandbetausers
directories.notes: People who volunteer to try early products. Nofollow. A fit for betas that need users, not for SEO.

directories.name: AppSumo
directories.notes: Lifetime-deal marketplace. A campaign can bring a burst of customers and support load. Terms are negotiated, not a flat directory fee.

directories.name: StackSocial
directories.notes: Software deals storefront. Distribution through a discount, with a commercial agreement rather than a simple listing.

directories.name: Dealify
directories.notes: Lifetime and limited deals. Read the revenue share before you treat it as a directory submit.

directories.name: Deal Mirror
directories.notes: Deal marketplace for software. Customers arrive expecting a discount.

directories.name: Prime Club
directories.notes: Software deals community. Confirm whether you are listing a deal or a full-price product.

directories.name: KEN Moo
directories.notes: Lifetime-deal listings. Only relevant if you are prepared to sell a discounted plan.

directories.name: PayOnceUseForever
directories.notes: Directory of pay-once software. A fit when you actually sell a lifetime license.

directories.name: RocketHub
directories.notes: Crowdfunding site, not a SaaS directory. Only useful if you are running a funding campaign.
